landing.heroSubtitle: AI-powered training programs tailored to your skill level and goals. Whether you're a beginner or advanced player, get personalized drills and progression plans.
landing.feature1Desc: Tell us your focus area and intensity level, and our AI creates a complete training program with progressive levels.
landing.feature2Desc: Log your daily training sessions and see your journey on a visual timeline. Never lose track of what you've practiced.
landing.feature3Desc: Get intelligent recommendations for your next training theme based on your recent sessions.
landing.feature4Desc: Prefer to design your own? Use our structured template to create and save custom training programs.
landing.feature5Desc: From footwork to smash technique, net play to doubles strategy — cover all aspects of badminton.
landing.feature6Desc: Choose 3 to 10 progression levels per program to match your improvement pace.
